title: Smart Helpdesk
description: AI-assisted help desk that resolves support queries by retrieving indexed procedures and manuals, citing the document that backs each answer.
problem: Support agents were checking scattered manuals to solve repetitive incidents. The help desk answers in natural language citing the exact procedure, reducing resolution time.

architecture.caption: Five layers: users, application, retrieval and generation, ingestion and data, and security with observability.

flow: The agent asks a support question in natural language through a direct-access application.
The App Service backend builds the pipeline, embeds the query and runs a hybrid search over the knowledge index.
The semantic ranker re-orders the results and selects the passages most likely to resolve the incident.
Azure OpenAI writes the answer relying only on those passages, citing the corresponding procedure.
The knowledge base is fed by uploading documents to Blob Storage; Document Intelligence processes them and the content is embedded and indexed.

components.name: Azure App Service
components.role: RAG orchestration and help desk frontend.

components.name: Azure AI Search
components.role: Support knowledge index with semantic re-ranking.

components.name: Azure Blob Storage
components.role: Repository of manuals, procedures and attachments.

insight.title: Accelerator reuse
insight.text: It shares platform and RAG pattern with the document chatbot: it is the same accelerator deployed twice. What sets them apart is the indexed corpus and the system prompt tuning, not the architecture — which shows the value of a reusable foundation.
